concerns.text: The plan states it will ingest “researcher‑provided 16S rRNA ASV counts and longitudinal clinical metadata from the PPMI cohort” (see Summary section). However, no publicly verified PPMI ASV or UPDRS dataset is cited or reachable; the required files must be supplied manually. This violates the Reproducibility principle (Constitution I) and makes the dataset inappropriate for an open, repeatable analysis, risking that the pipeline cannot be run by others without undisclosed data.
